func fuzz() {
extension Lexer.Lexeme {
  var isGenericTypeDisambiguatingToken: Bool {
    switch self.rawTokenKind {
    case .rightParen
      .rightSquare,
      .leftBrace,
      .rightBrace,
      .period,
      .comma,
      .semicolon,
      .endOfFile,
      .exclamationMark,
      .postfixQuestionMark,
      .colon:
      return true
    case .binaryOperator:
      return self.tokenText == "&"
    case .postfixOperator:
      return false
    case .leftParen, .leftSquare: return !self.isAtStartOfLine
    default:
      return false
    }
  }
}
}
